plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce broad market exposure.
Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Trim QQQI and QQQ to reduce exposure to downtrending broad tech.
Sell SMH due to its downtrend and trim CRWD to manage single-name concentration.
Buy XLV at 15% to diversify into a more defensive sector.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% monthly growth with a focus on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and diversifying holdings, but potential upside is limited.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Trim SOXL to a small 2% and sell SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF risk.
Trim SMH and QQQ to reduce exposure to downtrending tech.
Add to CRWD, an uptrending name, to 15% of the book.
Buy AAPU at 10% as a strong new scanner setup.
This plan balances risk and growth with a 10% cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech, offering moderate risk and return potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Add to SOXL (10%) and SPAL (5%) to increase leveraged exposure.
Sell QQQI to reallocate capital towards growth opportunities.
Trim SMH to 10% due to its downtrend.
Add to CRWD, concentrating 20% in this strong uptrending name.
Buy AAPU (15%) and ERX (10%) as high-scoring scanner setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. It carries significantly higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Add to SPY, increasing broad index exposure to 40% for stability.
Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Add to QQQI, increasing income-focused exposure to 30%.
Sell SMH and CRWD to reduce high-beta exposure.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth-oriented index exposure.
Buy XLV at 15% to diversify into a more defensive sector.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% monthly yield by rotating into income and broad index ETFs. It aims for low drawdown and steady distributions, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff. This is not a savings account.
